When: Tuesday 10:00 AM - 11:00 AM (UTC-05:00) Eastern Time (US & Canada)
Where: Microsoft Teams Meeting / Conference Room 4B

Colleagues,

In accordance with the engagement governance framework established at contract inception, a stakeholder review is hereby scheduled for the Quintero contract. The purpose of this session is to review the current position of the engagement with respect to Phase 2 and to ensure that all accountable parties are aligned prior to the next formal client touchpoint.

Attendees are requested to come prepared to speak to matters within their respective workstreams and to raise any items requiring collective consideration. Where positions differ, it is expected that these will be addressed within the session rather than deferred. Pre-read materials, to the extent available, will be circulated no later than close of business Monday via the engagement folder.

Please note that attendance is required. Should you be unable to attend, kindly nominate a delegate with appropriate authority and notify the organizer in advance.

Regards,
Sana
Hakimi Partners
